entries.what: Slept until about 1:30 p.m. after the Sunday-night shift, then made it to his 2 p.m. section at Bayshore State on the Tule Line half-awake.
entries.outcome: Got through class on Fatima's notes.

entries.what: Meal-prepped quickly, then Trevor picked him up in his Corolla for the first carpool to Ridgeline. Marcus gave him $20 for gas.
entries.outcome: Carpool replaces the bike; he no longer pedals to RF-4.

entries.what: First mandatory 10-hour night at Ridgeline RF-4, 9 p.m. to 7:30 a.m., on the cold dock with the new scanner quota. Peak pay of $24.75 an hour shows on his schedule.
entries.outcome: Finished at 7:30 a.m. and was wiped out.

entries.what: Got home around 8, ate eggs and rice, and slept from 8:30 until about 1:30 p.m. Jade texted when he woke up.
entries.outcome: Replied late with a quick apology.

entries.what: Free Tuesday afternoon with no class. Studied a bit for Biomechanics and bought groceries.
entries.outcome: Finished one chapter of reading.

entries.what: Carpooled to RF-4 with Trevor and worked the second overtime night. Trevor complained about rate all the way there.
entries.outcome: Hit rate and avoided a write-up.

entries.what: Shift ended at 7:30 a.m. and he got only a short sleep, since the stats tutoring center meets Wednesdays at 12:30 before class.
entries.outcome: Dragged himself to tutoring on about four hours of sleep.

entries.what: Asked his assistant how to keep strength on just two lifts a week now that the gym is cut to Fri/Sat mornings. He is chasing the 405 deadlift.
entries.outcome: Settled on a plan with a heavy deadlift day and a press-and-squat day.

entries.what: Afternoon section at Bayshore State, then carpooled to Ridgeline. The candidate forum on warehouse growth came up in break-room talk, but he skipped it.
entries.outcome: Another night on the cold dock.

entries.what: Slept 8:30 to 1:30 p.m. and woke up to Jade's texts. He joked about being a vampire and asked how to explain the overtime schedule so she would not read it as dodging her.
entries.outcome: Sent a joking but honest message about the nights.

entries.what: Afternoon section from 2 to 5:15, then a quick dinner at home before the carpool.
entries.outcome: Caught up with Fatima's shared notes.

entries.what: Fourth overtime night, with a freezer jacket on the cold dock. Trevor drove again.
entries.outcome: Made rate.

entries.what: Got off shift and went straight to Iron Flats Fitness for the first of his two weekly lifts, a heavy deadlift day, with Mike.
entries.outcome: Hit the planned lifts.

entries.what: Slept in the afternoon. Payday, since Ridgeline pays biweekly Fridays. Checked the deposit with the higher rate.
entries.outcome: Bigger paycheck, but he is too tired to enjoy it.

entries.what: Friday evening with no shift, since nights run Sunday through Thursday. Stayed in and rested while Arjun worked on his resume.
entries.outcome: Early night.

entries.what: Saturday morning gym session for his second lift of the week, with Mike spotting him.
entries.outcome: Pressed and squatted as planned.

entries.what: Slept through the afternoon and chatted with Jade about the week.
entries.outcome: Confirmed dinner plans.

entries.what: Saturday date night with Jade at Phở Bến Thành.
entries.outcome: Fell asleep a little at the table, which they laughed about.

entries.what: Sunday meal prep of chicken and rice, five containers, for the long overtime nights ahead.
entries.outcome: Containers ready.

entries.what: Texted his mom Denise and checked in on her week.
entries.outcome: Kept it light and did not mention how tired he is.

entries.what: Carpooled with Trevor to start the second overtime week, with the 9 p.m. start.
entries.outcome: On the cold dock again.
